name: Revitalist Lifestyle and Wellness Ltd.
summary: Revitalist Lifestyle and Wellness Ltd. (RVLWF) is a healthcare provider that operates medical clinics, specializing in a range of innovative mental health treatments. Its offerings include advanced therapeutic approaches like ketamine-enhanced and psychedelic-enhanced psychotherapy, along with medicative infusion therapy, vitamin infusions, and transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS). The company also provides traditional psychotherapy, other pharmacological interventions, and acupuncture. Founded in 2018, Revitalist has its corporate headquarters in Vancouver, Canada. As of March 31, 2022, it maintained a network of nine clinics located throughout the United States.
